cues.text: At the summer festival at Naganaki Shrine, you stand with Chihiro among the crowds and the food stalls, both of you watching someone pass by in a yukata.
You and Chihiro make your way through the crowd to a takoyaki stall, where a woman stands behind the counter.
You walk on together with the takoyaki to a stall hung with masks.
At the lucky-draw stall, you reach in and draw a ticket while Chihiro watches.
